sisi.depan: The far wall is dominated by a wide, recessed observation window of polarized black glass, below which runs a long control console covered in softly glowing blue glyphs.
sisi.kanan: A series of massive, vertical cryogenic conduits covered in frost pulse with faint light along the right wall, terminating near a heavy blast door sealed with a hexagonal locking wheel.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, the back wall is pierced by a single, wide entrance archway made of sharp-angled dark metal plates, flanked by two emergency coolant vents.
sisi.kiri: The left wall features a large rectangular aperture that serves as a drone maintenance bay, with a single personnel elevator shaft enclosed in transparent crystal set beside it.

tengah: A giant, slowly spinning blue ice crystal is suspended within a massive, frost-covered dark metal ring, with three concentric catwalks of perforated metal grating circling it at different heights.
atas: The cavernous ceiling is a dark network of thick, intersecting support beams and dangling power cables, from which clusters of harsh, downward-facing industrial floodlights cast a cold glare.
